authority: Canonical capability matrix — single source of truth per D-055
rule: A capability is not advertised as supported unless provider, fixture, validator, and failure behavior are all identified.

capabilities.name: Open/import
capabilities.limits: File size, page count, and encryption type bounded by provider admission

capabilities.name: Render/navigation
capabilities.limits: Rotation, crop boxes, mixed page sizes all covered

capabilities.name: Extractable text
capabilities.limits: Font-shaping ligatures and RTL text remain provider-dependent

capabilities.name: OCR fallback
capabilities.limits: English OCR only; multilingual, handwriting, low-contrast remain open

capabilities.name: Search
capabilities.limits: OCR-only and scanned text not yet searchable

capabilities.name: Text copy
capabilities.limits: Clipboard denied/empty/large-copy paths handled

capabilities.name: Links
capabilities.limits: Dangerous schemes blocked; only permitted schemes proceed after confirmation

capabilities.name: Outlines
capabilities.limits: Missing-target, duplicate, empty, and deep outlines handled

capabilities.name: Metadata
capabilities.limits: Malformed, Unicode, date, creator, producer, custom metadata safe

capabilities.name: Permissions
capabilities.limits: Missing, restricted, encrypted, provider-specific permissions surfaced

capabilities.name: Attachments
capabilities.claim: Inventory only until safe extraction passes
capabilities.limits: Name-tree inventory with Kids-subtree, duplicate detection, 8-entry synthetic corpus

capabilities.name: Password open
capabilities.limits: AES-256 user/owner password; wrong, empty, restricted paths handled

capabilities.name: Native AcroForms

native.note: Incremental form writer with appearance-stream regeneration

capabilities.limits: Text, checkbox, radio fields; source-preserving incremental update; non-FlateDecode xref streams fail closed

capabilities.name: Overlays
capabilities.limits: Reversible FreeText overlays; outside-region validation passes

capabilities.name: Signatures

native.note: Guard delivered: refuses edit on signed docs

capabilities.limits: Structural detection only; cryptographic validity and trust evaluation remain open

capabilities.name: XFA

native.note: Guard delivered: refuses edit on XFA docs

capabilities.limits: Static/dynamic/hybrid classification via heuristic; real XFA corpus remains open

capabilities.name: Tagged PDF
capabilities.limits: Detection and preservation only; authoring and compliant output remain open

capabilities.name: Reader accessibility
capabilities.limits: Human VoiceOver observation across all controls remains open

capabilities.name: Export validation
capabilities.limits: Bounded overlay/form exports validated; unrestricted external-form fidelity remains open

capabilities.name: Provider admission and revocation
capabilities.claim: Contract slice implemented; installer and live companion remain open
capabilities.limits: Exact artifact measurement, license-state rejection, source-limit checks; installer, cryptographic transport, sandboxing, live measurement, revocation feed remain open

unsupported_capabilities.name: Arbitrary text editing
unsupported_capabilities.note: Text-run replacement (simple ASCII) under active development; font/glyph/RTL/ligature preservation remains open

unsupported_capabilities.name: Image/vector/object redaction
unsupported_capabilities.note: Whiteout overlay rejection delivered; content removal remains open

unsupported_capabilities.name: Collaboration
unsupported_capabilities.note: Gen 3 target per PER-0926 evolution map

unsupported_capabilities.name: Sync
unsupported_capabilities.note: Gen 3 target per PER-0926 evolution map
